name: lb-names-full-rankings
note: Long leaderboard names scroll in their column instead of overflowing (issue #292; tests issue #455). A name wider than its column scrolls (marquee) on one line while a name that fits stays still; Narrator reads the whole name once in the row's single Button name (the raw MarqueeText adds nothing); every row is one 40+ epx stop in visual order, Up/Down between rows.
after_ready: assertread:id=fst.rankings.row.fixture-player-2|Rank #2, Fixture Player With An Extraordinarily Long Display Name That Never Fits. Total Score 88,000,000, 38 / 50 songs, button
assertread:id=fst.rankings.row.fixture-player-1|Rank #1, Fixture Player 1. Total Score 89,000,000, 39 / 50 songs, button

name: lb-names-full-rankings-text
note: Issue #455 text scaling (leaderboard-row R3, Windows large text = 150%, LargeText.Scale): at 150-225% text the long name wraps onto several still lines inside its column instead of scrolling (it never overflows into the songs label, score or chevron); a short name stays still and reserves the section's two-line name budget (R2, LeaderboardSection.NameLines), so its row is at least two name lines (50+ epx) tall; the row grows (R2), stays a 40+ epx stop read in full once, in rank order.
after_ready: assertread:id=fst.rankings.row.fixture-player-2|Rank #2, Fixture Player With An Extraordinarily Long Display Name That Never Fits. Total Score 88,000,000, 38 / 50 songs, button

after_ready: assertread:id=fst.rankings.row.fixture-player-2|Rank #2, Fixture Player With An Extraordinarily Long Display Name That Never Fits. Total Score 88,000,000, 38 / 50 songs, button

name: lb-names-budget-full-rankings
note: Issue #455 review (leaderboard-row R2 name budget): at 150-225% text every player row reserves two name lines (LeaderboardRowMetrics.PlayerNameLines, MarqueeText.MinLines), so a 16-character name (the longest an Epic display name gets), wrapped or not, and a short one keep one row height: every row is at least two name lines (50+ epx) tall and rank 1 -> 2 and rank 2 -> 3 have the same pitch. The names are still; the rows stay 48+ epx stops read in full once, in rank order. (UIA reports a raw name's text bounds, not its reserved lines, so the row and its pitch carry the check.)
after_ready: assertread:id=fst.rankings.row.fixture-player-2|Rank #2, Max Fixture Name. Total Score 88,000,000, 38 / 50 songs, button

name: lb-names-budget-overview-skeleton
note: Issue #455 review (leaderboard-row R2 name budget): on the Leaderboards overview at 150-225% text the loaded card rows (a short name and the wrapped 16-character name) and a loading card's placeholder rows (LeaderboardsSkeleton, same section budget) all have one pitch, so a card doesn't jump when its rows arrive. Placeholders stay raw-view only.
